result.description:
HOBAN Recruitment is partnering with a well-established national transport and logistics organisation that provides freight and supply chain solutions across Australia. Due to increased operational demands, we are seeking a versatile and reliable Warehouse Administrator / Forklift Operator to join their team. 
 This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys both administrative and warehouse responsibilities, with duties split between office-based coordination and hands-on warehouse operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Administration & Warehouse Systems 
 
 Processing and keying customer orders accurately into the Warehouse Management System (WMS) 
 Data entry and inventory administration 
 Updating shipment and warehouse records 
 Coordinating with warehouse and operations teams to ensure timely order processing 
 General administrative support as required 
 
 Warehouse Operations 
 
 Operating forklifts safely and efficiently 
 RF scanning and inventory management 
 Picking and packing orders 
 Loading and unloading freight 
 Assisting with stock movements and warehouse housekeeping 
 
 About You 
 To be successful, you will have:
